import numpy as np
df['주차_구분'] = np.where(df['주차'] <= 13, '1-13', '14-26')
meds = df.groupby('주차_구분')['CNT수율 (g/g-cat)'].median()
m1 = meds.get('1-13', None)
m2 = meds.get('14-26', None)
marks = []
if m1 is not None: marks.append({'type': 'vline', 'x': float(m1), 'text': f'Median 1-13: {m1:.1f}'})
if m2 is not None: marks.append({'type': 'vline', 'x': float(m2), 'text': f'Median 14-26: {m2:.1f}'})
